correctness.rationale: Independent full-rank second-difference rows ensure every subset of active constraints has a strictly complementary KKT input and local Jacobian P_A=I−D_A^T(D_AD_A^T)^−1D_A. Piecewise-linearity of convex-cone Euclidean projection yields global ℓ∞ Lipschitz L_n=max_A max_j Σ_k |(P_A)_(jk)|, with all faces locally attainable. Independent exact rational matrix calculations enumerate all active sets n=2..8: L2=1,L3=4/3,L4=7/5,L5=11/7; at n=5 the unique max is A={1,3}, output index j=3, matrix exactly the displayed 1/35 integer matrix. A strict KKT finite-distance pair gives ratio 11/7, not merely a limiting derivative. Embedding only constraints first and third in any n≥5 provides uniform L_n≥11/7; no sharp equality claimed above 5.
residual_risks: No exact formula for L_n for arbitrary n>5 is claimed; exact checked n=6,7,8 show larger values, consistent with the stated lower bound.
